text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaahhh!

Despite it being the weekend, Special
Week is
doing laps at full sprint.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've got a very, very important task today, so I'm preparing for it right now!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I have an idea! Could you come along
and cheer
me on?

I have no idea what's waiting for me, but
I decide
to join Special Week.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Here we are! This is where my big battle
is taking
place!

For some reason, there's a long table set
up in
front of a restaurant with an old
couple standing
next to it.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you, Spe!
Everything's
ready to go!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: We're counting on you today, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best! I hope I don't let you
down! Now,
let's get right to it.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit! Come on, hun! Let's
bring it all
out!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
Yes, dear! Here you go, Spe. Eat up,
now!

The old couple piles on the dishes one
after the
other.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, I agreed to help advertise this
lovely
couple's restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
They always cook up lots of delicious
meals for
me, so I wanted to return the
favor.

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
We came up with this idea since Spe
always looks
so happy when she eats our
food.

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
We thought it would be good publicity
if people
saw her eating up a storm in
front of our
restaurant!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I'm gonna eat a whole lot today to
show
everyone just how delicious the
food at this
restaurant is!

choice_data_list_en: So that's why you ran around to work up an appetite...
So that's why you ran around to work up an appetite, huh...

text_block_list.name: Man A
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and come see for yourself!
This
deary from Tracen Academy has put
in the order
of a century!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
She says she'll finish everything on our
menu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this looks real tasty! I can't wait to
dig in!

The booming voices of the couple and
Special
Week, as well as the food's
delicious aroma,
attract plenty of curious
onlookers.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I'll finish everything—no matter what it
takes!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Do you have any advice?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Got it! That's something I'm confident I
can do!
choice_data_list: 食べることを楽しもう！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All righty... Let's eat!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Nom! Munch, munch!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Good golly, this is tasty!

Special Week cleans every plate without
even
breaking a sweat.

The crowd floods right into the
restaurant. The
publicity campaign is a
huge success.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What?! What do you mean you've got
nothing?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Really? That's it?

enjoy
myself while I'm at it!
